subject.title: fix(acp): close shared state database on gateway shutdown (#100637)

question: Should maintainers make this ACP-only shutdown close the canonical fix for the linked SQLite handle leak, or prefer one of the broader ledger-lifecycle candidate PRs?
rationale: The code shape here is the narrowest one supported by current ownership, but multiple open PRs are racing on the same issue and one broader candidate claims real Windows file-lock proof, so automation should not choose the canonical landing path alone.

options.title: Land ACP-only after proof
options.body: Use this narrow shutdown fix once the contributor adds redacted real ACP shutdown or hot-reload proof, then close or supersede the duplicate PRs.

options.title: Prefer ledger lifecycle API
options.body: Choose a broader ledger close contract if maintainers want AcpEventLedger to own explicit lifecycle, accepting the extra API surface and compatibility review.

options.title: Pause competing PRs
options.body: Hold this PR and the sibling candidates until one maintainer-approved fix shape is selected for the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Land ACP-only after proof
recommendation.body: Use this narrow shutdown fix once the contributor adds redacted real ACP shutdown or hot-reload proof, then close or supersede the duplicate PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is currently assigned to steipete, and path history ties him to ACP startup and gateway lifecycle work.
